sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 80% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases max HP by 100% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
-Applies Emaciated Collapse (reduces healing effects by 70%) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
